basics.name: Jaime Gonzalez Gomez
basics.label: Researcher and Algorithm Engineer
basics.summary: I'm Jaime (also known as Jtachan), a problem-solving oriented person with interest for learning about any new skill. I believe the most important step for any solution is always to understand the logic of the algorithm and not leave it as a black box. This is always followed by the human-part of the same, as I believe all discussion with my colleagues will always help the solution to move forward.

work.name: Physicalisch-Technische Bundesanstalt (PTB)
work.summary: Researcher and main Python expert in the team. In charge of managing digitalisation python tools correlated with the DCC (Digital Calibration Certificate) project.
highlights: Improved communication and support among the current tasks of each member through agile methodologies.
Drastically improved the sturdiness of the software tools by introducing high quality code standards and CI/CD pipelines.
Designed, built and deployed Open-Source resources for people related to the DCC project around the globe.

work.name: Smart Microwave Sensors
work.summary: Python expert in the Tracking Team, in charge of developing solutions for the same to ease their debugging on recorded radar and camera tracking data. Other responsibilities were to cooperate with other teams within the company (Video Team, DevOps) and to provide constant support for 20+ internal Python tools.
highlights: Developed a 6-DoF sensor mounting position predictor taking as input a camera (sensor) image and mapping it to a satellite (top view) image.
Modified a prototype for an internal radar-fusion tool into a usable and high-reactive speed application.
Considered the best employee to train new employees to deliver high quality Python solutions.

work.name: Altran
work.summary:
Main engineer in all research projects in the autonomous-driving field. All projects required a design document and a final working prototype. Among all the projects, the main used technologies were radar, lidar, GPS, camera and neural-networks.

The most outstanding projects were:
highlights: A pedestrian tracking application, with a lidar mounted at the moving vehicle.
A driver-drowsiness detector, identifying the eyes of the driver (even with an FFP-2 mask) to display a high tone sound if the driver were to fall asleep.
An Autoencoder (Generative neural-network) to extract a camera-like image from a radar/lidar point-cloud as input.

work.name: University of Alcala de Henates (UAH)
work.summary: In charge of researching and developing a 6-DoF mathematical model for a driving vehicle. The model was used in a Kalman Filter as the predictor model for a lidar-odometry application over the KITTI database (lidar point-clouds for autonomous driving research).

publications.name: dccQuantities: A Python library for the Automated Evaluation and Uncertainty Propagation of Digital Calibration Certificates
publications.summary: dccQuantities is a Python package with the purpose to ease any previous manual work by providing an OOP library, which propagates the units and uncertainties of the data. The paper displays some solutions the library presents with real examples.

languages.summary: Proficient in English with a pretty good level of speaking, writing and comprehension abilities. Able to effectively communicate ideas and understand complex information in both personal and professional settings. Demonstrates strong grammar skills and a broad vocabulary.
Self-taught with multiple resources (DW German Course, Busuu, Easy-German YouTube channel). I can hold any conversation in any environment.

interests.name: Theatre / Role-Play
interests.description: Any table top role-playing is actually a great exercise to experience how other people would think and expand speaking abilities. With every situation there is a problem to be solved, one that many times does not allow for some previous preparation and that will require the work of multiple individuals.

interests.name: Cooking
interests.description:
Cooking any dish can be quite liberating, no matter if a recipe is to be followed or even if the final product was created by following your instincts. As a Spaniard, I find relaxing and amusing experimenting in the kitchen, trying to extract the maximum flavour of each ingredient together with others that would compliment them.

I also keep an online and open-source cookbook with every recipe I have tried and liked. This helps me to find my recipes fast and to share them among friends. See: https://jtachan.github.io/masalazafran/
